$comment: Hand-maintained, unlike finding-ids.json in this directory: this is a decision about what the package promises, not a derivation from source. src/index.js re-exports the generated core verbatim (plus flattenCrossFrameResult, internalsHookScript, listenerHookScript, liveRegionHookScript, addHowToCheck, howToCheckFor, proceduresFor, listProcedures, procedureChecklist, relatedRequirements, renderProcedures, HOOK_REASON_CODES, occurrenceOutcome, reviewGroupOf and leaningFailures), so every symbol the build emits reaches consumers whether or not it was meant to. Classifying each one here, and failing tests/public-api.test.js when the two disagree, is what makes the boundary deliberate. See docs/API_STABILITY.md#extension-points.
